title: How (un)ethical are instruction-centric responses of LLMs? Unveiling the vulnerabilities of safety guardrails to harmful queries
reasoning: The paper is centered on evaluating the 'unethical' and 'harmful' responses of LLMs, defining harm as divergence from human values and moral correctness. It introduces a benchmark dataset (TECHHAZARDQA) specifically to identify triggers for unethical responses across various technological domains and includes categories such as 'Hate Speech and Discrimination'.
